# Figure captions (generated by analysis/s2_figures.py)

### F1_outer_distributions — Outer-replicate distributions

Histograms (bin width 0.002) of the 500 outer-replicate values ΔC_corr(k) in each run. Blue lines: 95 % percentile interval endpoints (type-7 quantiles at 0.025/0.975). Black line: θ̂ = +0.0043 (Phase 9 primary). Dashed: 0. Annotations: run median, percentage of negative replicates, z₀. Conditional on 136 events / 316 censored in the 452-patient A-19 population.

*Source: reports/phase9/final_project/results/s1_interval_results.json. PROVISIONAL — as-run implementation; CV-seed protocol deviation not yet adjudicated.*

### F2_interval_comparison — Interval methods compared

Per-run 95 % intervals: percentile (primary, plan §7), basic = [2θ̂ − q.975, 2θ̂ − q.025] and bias-corrected z₀-only (acceleration 0; diagnostic). The basic interval is the reflection of the percentile interval about θ̂ = +0.0043; their divergence (≈ 52–56 % of the percentile width at each endpoint) breaches the W6/A7 warning in every run. Values: tables/T1_intervals_per_run.csv.

*Source: reports/phase9/final_project/results/s1_interval_results.json. PROVISIONAL — as-run implementation; CV-seed protocol deviation not yet adjudicated.*

### F3_endpoint_variability — Endpoint Monte-Carlo variability

Dots: per-run percentile endpoint. Thick bar: ±1 kernel MC-SE at the Silverman bandwidth (plan §2.2); thin bar: ±1 the largest kernel MC-SE over bandwidth × {0.5, 1, 2}. Grey band: mean ± between-run SD (ddof = 1, df = 4, relative SE ≈ 35 %). These are Monte-Carlo quantities; they are not sampling uncertainty and are never summed with it (MC-4). Values: tables/T2_kernel_MCSE.csv, T3_between_run.csv.

*Source: reports/phase9/final_project/results/s1_interval_results.json. PROVISIONAL — as-run implementation; CV-seed protocol deviation not yet adjudicated.*

### F4_MC1_running_trace — MC-1 running trace

Percentile endpoints computed from the first B outer replicates (k order), B = 50, 60, …, 500. W5 is evaluated on the Phase 6B MC-1 grid B ∈ {300, 400, 500} (final 40 %): spread > 0.05 × width is a warning. Highlighted: run 1 upper endpoint, the only W5 breach. Values: tables/T5_warnings_hardfailures.csv.

*Source: reports/phase9/final_project/results/s1_interval_results.json. PROVISIONAL — as-run implementation; CV-seed protocol deviation not yet adjudicated.*

### F5_EP1_grid — EP-1 evaluation grid

Each point is one EP-1 evaluation: MC-SE(endpoint) / (upper − lower) for one run, endpoint and MC-SE estimator. 39/40 evaluations are ≤ 0.05; the exception is run 1 upper at bandwidth × 0.5 (ratio 0.0535). All 10 pass at the Silverman bandwidth and all 10 pass with the between-run SD. The plan does not state which estimator governs EP-1; the outcome is reported as UNRESOLVED. Values: tables/T4_EP1_grid.csv.

*Source: reports/phase9/final_project/results/s1_interval_results.json. PROVISIONAL — as-run implementation; CV-seed protocol deviation not yet adjudicated.*

### F6_shift_decomposition — Observed shift decomposition

Pooled histograms over 2 500 outer replicates. Black line: original-data value (Phase 9 primary: ΔC_app(D), ΔOpt(D) = mean over 5 seeds, θ̂). Blue line: outer-replicate mean. ΔC_corr(k) = ΔC_app(k) − ΔOpt(k); the outer mean exceeds θ̂ by +0.0097, of which +0.0083 comes from a higher apparent ΔC on D*ₖ and +0.0014 from a lower ΔOpt. Descriptive only: the original-data values were produced by Phase 9 primary, under a different seeding convention (deviation record §8).

*Source: reports/phase9/final_project/results/s1_interval_results.json. PROVISIONAL — as-run implementation; CV-seed protocol deviation not yet adjudicated.*
